description: Registry of AI knowledge artifacts for this Next.js template. `ai/` is the source of truth; `.claude/` is generated by scripts/sync-ai-adapters.mjs.

rules.summary: Feature-based structure under src/. Features don't import each other; shared code lives directly under src/. Server Components by default; 'use client' only when needed.
Use @/ aliases, never deep relative (../../). Imports are grouped and alphabetized (import/order). One blank line between groups.
No console.log (warn/error only). No nested ternary. eqeqeq. Boolean names start is/has/should/can/did/will/are. Blank line before return. id-length >= 2.
kebab-case files, PascalCase components/types, camelCase vars/fns, use-prefixed hooks, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants.
strict mode. No explicit any. Prefer type inference; type props/returns at boundaries. Validate external data with Zod.
Unit/component tests with Vitest + Testing Library (renderApp helper). E2E with Playwright in e2e/. Test behavior, not implementation.

skills.summary: Where code goes: src/app routes, src/features slices, shared src/ folders. Import boundaries and the feature data-layer pattern.
Next.js 16 App Router: server/client components, async params, layouts, error/not-found files, and proxy.ts (renamed middleware).
Data fetching: Axios api-client, typed queryOptions factories, useQuery/useMutation hooks, and SSR prefetch + HydrationBoundary.
Forms with React Hook Form + Zod resolver and the shadcn Form/FormField/FormMessage components.
Add or author shadcn/ui-style components: cn(), cva variants, Radix primitives, forwardRef, Tailwind v4 tokens.
Internationalization with next-intl: routing config, message catalogs, useTranslations, locale-aware navigation, proxy.ts.
Global client state with Zustand stores, including reading state outside React via getState().
Error boundaries (react-error-boundary), App Router error.tsx/global-error.tsx/not-found.tsx, and the notifications store.
Unit/component testing with Vitest + Testing Library, the renderApp provider wrapper, and user-event.
End-to-end tests with Playwright in e2e/, role-based locators, web-first assertions, and the webServer config.
Conventional commit messages enforced by commitlint: allowed types, scope, granular commits.

agents.summary: Reviews diffs against the template's rules: architecture boundaries, imports, code style, types, accessibility.
Writes Vitest/Testing Library unit tests and Playwright E2E tests following the template's conventions.
Keeps README, feature docs, and the ai/ knowledge base in sync with code changes.
